output_list.criticism: The function addguess is intended to receive a guess as input and store it. However, the code has a local variable assignment where the timestamp is stored in block_timestamp and immediately used. This may cause the integer overflow in the variable. If the block.timestamp overflows, the guess is discarded and not recorded. It might cause a loss of funds. Moreover, if a guess is made very frequently, the same guess can be made over and over again, and the same guess will always be the smallest. As a result, there is always a guess that can win, which means the contract is predictable.
